role: Frozen research baseline for requested batching/SQP/continuation comparisons

protocol.initialization: Public pose-reaching: cold repeated actual rest state and zero controls; then bsqp.common shift of previous output reanchored at actual state. Reset dual and rho once per episode; retain adaptive rho and duals across feedback solves. First t0 solve supplies first executed prefix and is recorded.
protocol.comparison: One bounded OFF contrast with ordinary u_cost .00001: running/terminal orientation0/0, all other M14 settings and primary position+speed5cm gate unchanged. Compare with LOW_TORQUE to isolate orientation at the same lower ordinary torque weight; compare with original OFF canonical separately. Original OFF failure preserved. Matching canonical must pass before any full ordered development12; no timeout waiver or criterion change.

limit_penalty.core_change: Reviewed C2 quadratic continuation plus explicit interior cost bounds at all value/gradient/Hessian callsites; raw limits, dynamics and controller unchanged.

cost_bounds.initial_states: Unchanged, including those outside interior cost bounds; no clipping or filtering.

protocol.orientation_scale_motivation: Original running/terminal orientation-to-position weight ratios both .025: a 1rad weighted RPY error-norm is equivalent in quadratic cost to about158mm Cartesian position error. LOW ratio .0025 gives about50mm per1rad (100mm per2rad); OFF removes the orientation-goal cost, leaving positional IK redundancy. These are cost equivalents for wrapped RPY components, not physical rotation angles or success guarantees.
protocol.torque_scale_motivation: The ordinary torque quadratic coefficient falls10x, while the torque barrier stays fixed. Zero-torque barrier curvature is2*ctrl_lim_cost/U_cost^2:2.994e-5 for joints1/2,8.190e-5 for3..7 cost/Nm^2. Total zero-torque curvature changes from1.2994e-4/1.8190e-4 to3.994e-5/9.190e-5, reductions about3.25x/1.98x. Curvature at nonzero gravity torque is larger; this is not a uniform10x total-cost reduction or a predicted motion outcome.

selection_basis: Development12 orientation and ordinary-torque contrasts only; user asks freeze working configuration and continue batching, extra SQP and continuation ablation. Not chosen using fresh100 validation outcomes.
limitations: 9/12 rough position+speed arrivals; no orientation arrival criterion; not reliability or safety qualification
